{{Quote|It doesn't matter. My species has encountered the Yuuzhan Vong before. Even in small numbers they were almost unstoppable. We have to give Artorias a chance&mdash;we have to let them know&hellip;the Yuuzhan Vong are coming.|Panha|<ref name="Invasion #0">[[Invasion 0|''Invasion'' 0]]</ref>}}
A '''battle''' occurred at [[Vun'Hanna]] and the [[Twilight Void/Legends|Twilight Void]] within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] and [[Praetorite Vong]] which took place by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. The battle ultimately ended in the defeat of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces.

==Background==
The [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] had begun [[Praetorite Vong|a migration]] into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in preparation for their planned settlement at least as early as [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] when they began their attack upon [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]]. By [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a small [[Yuuzhan Vong reconnaissance force|reconnaissance force]] encountered a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Ar'alani's force|force]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]], and attacked with immediate ferocity. The [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet]] force was destroyed after it attacked with significant ferocity.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|There's an invasion coming. A massive assault force of dark ships, shadowy figures, and weapons of great power, based on organic technology of a sort we've never seen before. We believe these Far Outsiders, as we call them, already have a foothold at the far edge of the galaxy, and even now have scouting parties seeking information on worlds and peoples to conquer...|Kinman Doriana|<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
Shortly after the attack, [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] encountered the ''[[Bargain Hunter]]'', leading to fears that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Yuuzhan Vong were allies staging a joint invasion against the Chiss Ascendancy. When [[Special Task Force One]] arrived in the Unknown Regions and [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]] used the threat of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] falling into the hands of the Yuuzhan Vong as a pretext to destroy the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'', Thrawn was convinced to agree to the plan due to the knowledge of the difficulty the Chiss had faced against the limited Yuuzhan Vong scout force.<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> 

Years later, at the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Panha]] would mention the skirmish to [[Sarkkin]].<ref name="Invasion #0" /> In the year [[55 ABY]], the author [[Lenang O'Pali/Legends|Lenang O'Pali]] mentioned the encounter at [[Vun'Hanna]] and the [[Twilight Void/Legends|Twilight Void]] in the publication ''[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo Reconsidered: A Patriot's Perspective]]''.<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
